sn35.246:1.1: Yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu uppajjeyya chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭigham vā pi cetaso tato cittaṃ nivāraye ||
sn35.246:1.2: Sabhayo ceso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kummaggo ca duhitiko ca ||
sn35.246:1.3: asappurisasevito ceso maggo na ceso maggo sappurisehi sevito ||
sn35.246:1.5: tato cittaṃ nivāraye cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi || || pe ||
sn35.246:1.6: Yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu || pe ||
sn35.246:1.7: manoviññeyyesu dhammesu uppajjeyya chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vā pi cetaso tato cittaṃ nivāraye ||
sn35.246:1.8: Sabhayo ceso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahaṇo ca ummaggo ca kummaggo ca duhitiko ca ||
sn35.246:1.9: asappurisasevito ceso maggo na ceso maggo sappurisehi sevito ||
sn35.246:2.2: kitthārakkho ca pamatto || goṇo ca kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭham otaritvā yāvadatthaṃ madam āpajjeyya || ||
sn35.246:2.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano chasu phassāyatanesu asaṃvutākārī pañcasu kāmaguṇesu yāvadatthaṃ madam āpajjati || || 5
sn35.246:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ kiṭṭhārakkho ca apamatto || goṇo ca kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭham otareyya
sn35.246:3.2: tam enaṃ kiṭṭhārakkho nāsāya sugahitaṃ gaṇheyya ||
sn35.246:3.3: nāsāyaṃ suggahitaṃ gahetvā upari ghāṭāya suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya
sn35.246:3.4: upari ghaṭāyam suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitam tāḷeyya ||
sn35.246:3.7: Tatiyam pi kho bhikkhave goṇo kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭham otareyya
sn35.246:3.8: tam enaṃ kiṭṭhārakkho nāsāya suggahitaṃ gaṇheyya ||
sn35.246:3.9: nāsāyaṃ sugahitaṃ gahetvā upari ghaṭāya suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya ||
sn35.246:3.10: upari ghāṭāya suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya ||
sn35.246:3.12: hi so bhikkhave goṇo kiṭṭhādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā || na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya ||
sn35.246:3.14: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yato kho bhikkhuno chasu phassāyatanesu cittam ujujātaṃ hoti saṃmujujātam ajjhattam eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodihoti samādhiyati || || 6
sn35.246:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā vīṇāya saddo assutapubbo assa ||
sn35.246:4.4: Ambho kissa nu kho eso saddo evaṃ rajaniyo evaṃ kamaniyo evam madaniyo evam mucchaniyo evam bandhaniyo ti ||
sn35.246:4.6: Eso kho bhante vīṇā nāma yassā eso saddo evaṃ rajaniyo evaṃ kamaniyo evaṃ madaniyo evaṃ mucchaniyo evam bandhaniyo ti ||
sn35.246:4.8: Gacchatha me bho tam vīṇam āharathāti || ||
sn35.246:4.11: Ayaṃ kho sā bhante viṇā yassā eso saddo evaṃ rajaniyo evaṃ kamaniyo evam madaniyo evam mucchaniyo evam bandhaniyoti ||
sn35.246:4.13: Alam me bho tāya vīṇāya taṃ eva me saddam āharathāti || ||
sn35.246:4.15: Ayaṃ kho bhante vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā
sn35.246:4.17: doṇiñca paṭicca cammañca paṭicca daṇḍañca paṭicca upaveṇañ ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañ ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmam paṭicca evāyam bhante vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā
sn35.246:4.19: so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya || dasadhā vā satadhā tam phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya ||
sn35.246:4.20: sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya || agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya ||
sn35.246:4.21: masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā opuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya ||
sn35.246:4.23: asakkirāyam bho vīṇā nāma yatheva yaṃ kiñci vīṇā nāma ettha ca mahājano ativelam pamatto palaḷito ti || || 7
sn35.246:4.24: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpam samanesati yāvatā rūpassa gati || vedanaṃ samanesati || pe || saññaṃ || saṅkhāre || viññāṇaṃ samanesati yāvatā viññāṇassa gati ||
sn35.246:4.29: yam pissa taṃ hoti Ahan ti vā Mamanti vā Asmīti vā tam pi tassa na hotīti || || 3
